title: DSTP002
content:
[vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Job Role – Project Assistant"]Qualifications – Diploma in Engineering & Technology Experience – 2-3 years of experience in social sector/ Education / Livelihood Location – Mysore No. of Vacancies – 01 Salary – 20,000/+HRA   Role and Responsibilities
  • The Project Assistant is responsible to execute the work assigned by the Project coordinator
  • Maintaining Electrical and Mechanical equipment/ Systems/Network/Internet in operating condition 24×7.
  • Researching new techniques and ways of repairing commonly used equipment’s, tools, water pump sets other necessary devices within the co-working space, with the help of assistance from the locals in the region by supporting the targeted beneficiaries.
  • Duties assigned by the PI, Co-PI and Project coordinator to be completed as per the timeline and should be available in the campus on duty hours
  Basic Qualifications & Competencies
  • Diploma in Engineering & Technology
  • 2-3 years of experience in social sector/ Education / Livelihood
  • Ability to work independently & collaboratively with internal & external Stakeholders
  • Excellent written & verbal skills (in Kannada, English is desirable and in Hindi is preferable)
[/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][/vc_row]
